当开发HarmonyOS应用时，ArkTS是必须使用的编程语言
无论是UI开发、业务逻辑编写还是系统能力调用，都需要使用ArkTS语言
当应用中存在耗时任务（CPU密集型、I/O密集型）需要避免阻塞UI主线程时，请使用TaskPool或Worker进行多线程并发处理
当需要在线程间高效传递数据时，请使用Sendable对象和共享容器
当需要对应用代码进行混淆保护以防止逆向工程时，请使用ArkGuard的源码混淆或字节码混淆能力
当需要优化应用的启动性能和模块加载效率时，请使用延迟加载和动态加载能力
用 TaskPool 把图片压缩或 JSON 解析放到后台线程执行 / Offload image compression or JSON parsing to a background thread with TaskPool
用 Worker 处理长期运行的计算任务并避免阻塞 UI / Run long-lived compute work in a Worker to avoid blocking the UI
在线程之间传递 Sendable 数据对象减少拷贝开销 / Pass Sendable objects across threads to reduce copy overhead
实现异步锁保护共享状态避免并发读写冲突 / Protect shared state with async locks to avoid concurrent read-write conflicts
使用 async/await 编排多个异步请求和顺序任务 / Coordinate multiple async requests and sequential tasks with async/await
给 ArkTS 应用接入源码混淆和字节码混淆保护 / Integrate source and bytecode obfuscation for an ArkTS app
用 ArkGuard 混淆发布包代码防止逆向分析 / Obfuscate release builds with ArkGuard to resist reverse engineering
通过 lazy import 延迟加载页面或模块优化冷启动 / Lazy-load pages or modules with lazy import to improve cold start
把 CPU 密集型排序或加密计算迁移到多线程执行 / Move CPU-intensive sorting or encryption work to multithreaded execution
管理 Worker 与主线程之间的消息通信和生命周期 / Manage messaging and lifecycle between Workers and the main thread
编写高性能 ArkTS 并发代码处理大数据计算 / Write high-performance ArkTS concurrent code for large-data processing
在 ArkTS 中实现类型安全的业务逻辑和模块开发 / Implement type-safe business logic and modules in ArkTS

postconditions.statement: 已在ArkTS源码或配置中实现所请求的语言/并发/加载/混淆改动 / The requested language, concurrency, module-loading, or obfuscation changes are implemented in ArkTS source or configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits add or modify ArkTS code or related build/config files to implement the requested ArkTS capability rather than only providing explanation?

postconditions.statement: 所选并发模型与需求匹配，未将UI相关实现误替换为非对应Kit能力 / The chosen concurrency model matches the requirement, and the edits do not incorrectly replace UI-oriented work with unrelated kit functionality
postconditions.judge_prompt: From the edit set, is the solution centered on ArkTS language/runtime features (such as async/await, TaskPool, Worker, Sendable, lazy import, or ArkGuard) and not primarily on UI, Ability, Form, Web, or IPC APIs?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及构建、懒加载或混淆，相关配置项已同步更新到对应工程文件 / If build, lazy loading, or obfuscation is involved, the relevant project configuration has been updated accordingly
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the request involves build options, lazy import/dynamic loading, or ArkGuard, do the edits also update the appropriate project configuration files or import/loading statements?
